title: Streamlined vendor insurance negotiation flow + SOC2 evidence bundling for self-serve contracts
creator: Amara Patel
description: Goal: create a repeatable, low-friction path for mid-market customers to complete procurement checks (SOC2 evidence, insurance certs) while supporting a pricing experiment that reduces friction for self-serve contracts. Current intake is manual: sales/procurement hand-off, email attachments, and ad-hoc evidence requests. That increases time-to-close and support load. This ticket designs an automated negotiation flow that bundles a curated SOC2 "lite" evidence pack (common artifacts), surfaces missing items via a vendor portal checklist, and integrates a templated insurance negotiation worksheet for legal/procurement to accept or counter - with clear hooks for pricing adjustments if certain risk thresholds are met.
acceptance_criteria:
1) A Confluence spec for the vendor-facing portal checklist and SOC2-lite evidence bundle is published and reviewed by Security and Legal by 2025-02-28.
2) Prototype of the vendor portal flow implemented in the staging Console UI with mock evidence upload and verification flags.
3) Insurance negotiation worksheet template (fillable PDF) available in Drive + linked from portal.
4) Pricing experiment matrix defined: risk-tier -> onboarding surcharge / discount rules, and A/B test plan ready.
5) Instrumentation events defined and implemented by ENG for time-to-onboard, evidence completeness rate, and legal review turnaround.
6) Pilot with 5 customers (mix of self-serve and sales-assisted) executed and initial metrics collected by 2025-03-18.
